diagram_math_checks.check: Gluing F1 and F2 along one interval gives chi(F)=chi(F1)+chi(F2)-1. With each of F,F1,F2 connected and one-boundary, F2 supplies chi=1-2g. Thus 2-2(g1+g2)=2-2g(F), so g(F)=g1+g2. The planar silhouettes explicitly suppress handles and make no genus-zero assertion. This counts b(F)=b(F1)=b(F2)=1, not three boundaries after an interior-circle cut.
